Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bambamR 0.2.0

Bug fixes

  • bb_align() with aligner = "STAR" now decompresses gzipped FASTQ files with gunzip -c instead of zcat. The zcat shipped with macOS only reads .Z files, so STAR could not read .fastq.gz input there.
  • bb_edger() now stops with a clear message when group has a single level and no design is given, or when group contains missing values. Both cases previously failed with an unrelated error from the model matrix.
  • bb_qc() computes GC content and per-position quality in time linear in the number of bases; the per-position summary previously looped over every read for every position. Reads are processed in blocks of about ten million bases, so memory stays bounded for long reads as well. Results are unchanged.
  • bb_qc(): use_fastqc is documented as reserved and ignored; it never called FastQC.
  • bb_oncoplot() no longer fails when a custom mutation_colors vector has no "Other" entry and the data contain an unlisted mutation type (a neutral gray is used), or when genes contains duplicates. n_genes, genes, mutation_colors and annotation_df are validated, and a warning is raised when no row name of annotation_df matches a sample instead of dropping the tracks silently.
  • bb_edger(), bb_limma_voom() and TMM normalization no longer print the edgeR 4.0 notice that calcNormFactors() was renamed to normLibSizes().
  • bb_volcano() no longer warns about removed rows for every unlabeled gene, and drops rows without a fold change. bb_volcano() and bb_ma_plot() accept an unnamed colors vector in the documented order and report wrong names clearly; n_label = 0 draws no labels.
  • bb_heatmap() shows a single-sample matrix as zeros instead of missing tiles when scaling, and bb_heatmap() and bb_pca() validate n_genes and the metadata arguments.

Plot readability

  • bb_oncoplot(): the legend is collected below the whole figure with its title on top and at most three columns, so it is no longer clipped at the device edge; the top barplot title is split over two lines and no longer runs into the plot title, and its axis of gene counts uses whole-number breaks. Annotation tracks drawn without barplots collect their legends in the same way. When moving the legend, reset its layout too: for the patchwork composition use p & ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right") & ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(ncol = 1)), for a single ggplot (show_barplot = FALSE, no annotation_df) use + instead of &.

  • bb_heatmap(): the Z-score color scale is symmetric, so the middle color always marks zero; with annotation_col, sample labels are drawn once below the annotation track instead of twice and overlapping.

  • bb_plot_qc(): the Q20 and Q30 thresholds are labeled and use a color-blind-safe pair with different line types; the read-length histogram uses one bin per length for narrow ranges and whole-number axis breaks. The combined panel draws the file legend once instead of three times, which leaves more room for the panels.

  • Shiny app: plots are drawn at 96 dpi instead of 72 dpi, so axis and gene labels are readable in the result tabs. The PCA and MA tabs say why they are empty (no condition column, or a DE method without mean expression) instead of staying blank, and the DE table shows three significant digits.

Documentation

  • Figures in the tutorial, quick-start and oncoplot vignettes carry alt text.
  • The custom volcano example in the vignettes uses cutoffs that leave significant genes, so the custom colors are visible.
  • The GitHub icon in the site navigation bar has an accessible label.

CRAN preparation

  • bb_pipeline() now writes to a new directory below tempdir() by default instead of "bambamR_output" in the working directory; pass output_dir to keep results.
  • Examples no longer contain commented-out calls: BAM and counting examples build a tiny BAM file when ‘Rsamtools’ is installed, the pipeline example runs in minimal mode, and bb_align() documents why its example cannot run.
  • Documented return values of the print and summary methods.
  • DESCRIPTION: shorter title, quoted software names, Language and SystemRequirements for the optional external tools.

Integrity fixes

  • Preserve requested BAM columns and their types when the Rsamtools reader encounters a valid file with no alignments. Empty results now support the same field selection as populated results.

  • Expand existing Windows short read-path aliases before HISAT2 admission; preserve bare index names and the caller’s original path provenance.

  • Normalize Windows path separators before HISAT2 alias admission while preserving literal backslashes in Unix filenames and original input paths.

  • Preserve HISAT2 FASTQ/index paths containing spaces or shell punctuation with private temporary aliases, including compressed reads and large indexes. Retain original input paths in the result; reject unsafe optional arguments that the upstream wrapper would parse through a second shell.

  • Preserve separate FASTQ alignment products and sample names; reject ambiguous pipeline entry points, incompatible skipped steps and output replacement.

  • Check external command status/products and quote argument tokens. HISAT2 SAM output no longer contains diagnostics. Paired featureCounts requests fragments.

  • Match named TPM lengths and metadata by identifier, reject invalid counts and empty libraries, preserve edgeR adjustment variables, and repair limma contrasts.

  • Fail requested DE explicitly; retain plot warnings in the saved result.

  • Validate FASTQ records and limit reads when a sample size is requested.

  • Clear stale Shiny results, implement previews and normalization selection, and provide a normalization-only mode. TPM remains available through the R API.

  • Preserve the oncoplot cohort denominator, display requested annotation tracks, and label unscaled heatmaps as expression rather than Z-scores.

Compatibility: use a fresh output directory for each alignment/pipeline run. Metadata must now match all samples. Supply external-tool options as separate argument tokens. limma returns one contrast per call. See MAINTENANCE.md for validation evidence and remaining release gates.

bambamR 0.1.0

  • Standardize the named v5 package logo across README, documentation pages and available application headers, with matching light and dark artwork.

New features

  • Initial release of bambamR.
  • Data import: bb_read_fastq() and bb_read_bam() with ShortRead/Rsamtools or base-R/system-samtools fallback.
  • Quality control: bb_qc(), bb_qc_summary(), and bb_plot_qc() for per-read quality, GC content, and read-length distributions.
  • Alignment: bb_align() wrapping STAR, HISAT2, and minimap2.
  • Read counting: bb_count_reads() via GenomicAlignments or featureCounts.
  • Normalization: bb_normalize() supporting CPM, TPM (base R), TMM (edgeR), and RLE (DESeq2).
  • Differential expression: bb_deseq2(), bb_edger(), and bb_limma_voom() returning standardized result data.frames.
  • Visualization: bb_oncoplot(), bb_volcano(), bb_heatmap(), bb_pca(), bb_ma_plot() — all return ggplot2 objects.
  • Pipeline orchestrator: bb_pipeline() runs the full analysis from FASTQ, BAM, or count matrix to plots in a single call.
  • Export: bb_export_csv(), bb_export_tsv(), bb_export_rds().
  • Shiny app: bb_run_app() launches an interactive analysis dashboard.
  • Example data: bb_example_counts(), bb_example_mutations(), and bb_example_de() provide bundled datasets for exploring all features.
  • Two operating modes: minimal (CRAN-only) and full (+ Bioconductor). All Bioconductor dependencies are optional and checked at runtime.

Bug fixes

  • None yet.
